label: Air temperature
description: W1-end sensor, used for every bed (no sensor at W2); 10-min median at the run

label: Air temperature, W3 end
description: W3-end sensor; reads ~3 °C warmer than the W1 end in the afternoon

label: Relative humidity
description: W1-end sensor, 10-min median at the run

label: Relative humidity, W3 end
description: W3-end sensor, 10-min median at the run

label: Vapour pressure deficit
description: from env_air_t and env_rh; the evaporative demand on the leaves

label: Light (PAR sensor)
description: raw sensor output, not converted to µmol m⁻² s⁻¹; nearest 15-min reading

label: Demand since last watering
description: VPD integrated over time since the bed was last watered (schedule 11:00 and 19:00; W2/W3 dry 3–15 Sep)

label: Hours since last watering
description: time since the bed was last watered

label: Global radiation, outside
description: DWD station Belm (11 km), 30-min mean around the run

label: Sunshine, last hour
description: DWD station Belm: share of the hour before the run with direct sun

label: Sky at the run
description: sunny (sun ≥ half the last hour), cloudy, or dark (< 20 W/m²); from DWD Belm, independent of the greenhouse

label: Greenhouse light
description: greenhouse light sensor (mV) scaled to DWD global radiation on hourly daytime means; outside-equivalent, so it includes the losses through the greenhouse cover
